title: Anmeldung mit E-Mail und Passwort
description: As a developer, I want to log in with my e-mail and password, so that I can manage the prompts of my organisation.

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered and confirmed developer account exists
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and a signed JWT access token
and: the token contains the claims sub, organisation_id, role and exp
the password is never part of the response or of any log line
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-001-login.feature: Successful login returns a signed access token

acceptance_criteria.when: the developer submits a wrong password
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 401 and a generic error message
and: the response and the timing are indistinguishable from the case of an unknown e-mail address
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-001-login.feature: Wrong password is rejected without leaking account existence

acceptance_criteria.given: an account has already failed to authenticate 9 times within a minute
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer submits a further invalid login attempt
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 429 and the account is temporarily locked
and: the lock is released automatically after the configured lockout period
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-001-login.feature: Repeated failed logins are rate limited
